open_text_result: Four direct Strabo passages naming Menekrates of Elaea were checked in a non-OCR TEI: 12.3.22–23 (Hellespontiaca/land circuit context), 12.8.3 (Mysian account), and 13.3.3 (Peri ktiseon). Together they preserve the material behind FHG II p.342, but the old editor's precise fr.1–3 divisions still need a line-by-line collation before calling this an edition-identical reconstruction.

next_action: Use the four checked Strabo loci as open source text; collate them with FHG II p.342 to assign the three fragment numbers before any normalized release. Do not use DFHG as a text source because its own documentation describes OCR-derived content.
notes: This is Menekrates of Elaea (not the Xanthian/Nysaean/Olynthian namesakes). A secondary FHG-index source confirms the two titles Ktiseis and Hellespontiaca. The 12.3.23 continuation is retained with 12.3.22 rather than counted as a separate Canon fragment.
